page.title: Exposure
page.purpose: Manage which scenarios are reachable from outside Vrooli, with explicit duration, readiness, authentication scope, and post-action verification.

priorities.statement: Expose is a guided decision, not a raw text submission.
Lease duration and expiry are explicit before confirmation.
The publicness boundary is explicit: the application stays protected unless the operator deliberately enables /public/* bypass.
The result includes a public URL and end-to-end verification state.

states.description: Routes, scenario candidates, and probe classifications are loading.
Active routes, search, filters, and the primary expose action are available.
No active exposures exist; the first-exposure action explains the value and safety model.
Route inventory is usable but one supporting readiness or probe source is unavailable.
The last route inventory remains visible while reconciliation or refresh is pending.
The selected scenario cannot be exposed until a named port, lifecycle, or route issue is resolved.
The exposure is being provisioned and the current step is visible.
The public URL, expiry, policy scope, and verification result are shown.
Provisioning failed with a classified reason and retry or remediation path.

claims.statement: The exposure inventory supports search and filtering by tier, health, lease state, and access policy.
The operator chooses and reviews lease duration before exposure is submitted.
The confirmation states that anonymous access, when enabled, is limited to /public/* and does not weaken the primary application.
Successful exposure reports the resulting public URL, lease expiry, and local/tunnel/external verification states.

regions.note: Counts, readiness warning, and one dominant expose action.
Responsive collection: table on wide screens, action cards on narrow screens.
Drawer or dialog wizard layered over the inventory.
